reviews.text: Amazing, especailly if you have dry skin! I have never seen more noticable skin benefits from another sunscreen! Keeps my skin so hydrated and healthy looking all day long in a non greasy type of way. My skin has gradually started to look more luminous and bright and this has been the only thing I’ve added into my skin routine that’s been different. my skin is very sensitive and I’ve had no breakouts, stinging, or burning eyes! feels like a very soothing and hydrating face cream!
reviews.zh: 好正，尤其係乾性皮膚！我未見過其他防曬有咁明顯嘅皮膚效果！全日都令皮膚保持好水潤、健康，又唔油膩。我皮膚慢慢開始睇落更加有光澤、更明亮，而呢款係我護膚程序入面唯一改變咗嘅嘢，都帶嚟唔同嘅效果。我皮膚好敏感，但冇爆痘、冇刺痛，亦冇眼睛灼熱！感覺好似一款好舒緩、補濕嘅面霜！

reviews.text: I love this product mostly because it will allow me to wear a sunscreen daily without hating it. It is no thicker than a lightweight moisturizer, applies beautifully, doesn't leave a hint of white cast and doesn't sting my eyes. 💚 I must say it looks a little too shiny on my oily-combination skin, so i am considering trying the other sunscreen by purito next. But for the people who prefer a dewy and glowing look this is an amazing product.
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意呢款產品，因為佢令我可以每日用防曬，又唔會覺得討厭。佢嘅厚度同輕盈保濕霜差唔多，塗得好漂亮，完全冇白色殘留（white cast）嘅感覺，亦唔會刺痛我嘅眼睛。💚 我必須講，喺我嘅油性混合性皮膚上，佢睇落有少少過於反光，所以我考慮下一步試吓 purito 嘅另一款防曬。但係對於鍾意水潤、有光澤外觀嘅人嚟講，呢款係一款好正嘅產品。

reviews.text: I have tried several SPFs and this is one of the best. I have a dry face and SPF works for me. It spreads well, absorbs quickly into the skin and leaves a nice dewy finish. It doesn't stay white on my face or sting my eyes ❤️. The consistency is soft and light. I use it as the last step in my routine. It behaves well with other products, it does not smudge. I am very satisfied and will definitely buy this product next time.
reviews.zh: 我試過好幾款防曬，呢款係其中最好嘅一款。我皮膚偏乾，防曬對我好啱。推得開，吸收快，留下好靚嘅水潤光澤。唔會喺面上留低白色，亦唔會刺痛我嘅眼睛 ❤️。質地柔軟輕盈。我當係護膚嘅最後一步用。同其他產品配合得好，唔會搓花。我好滿意，下次一定會再買。

reviews.text: I was using before the Comfy water version , which was good, but I had a feeling it did not really absorb into my skin completely. I have mixt skin type and this version I can say its perfect for me. During summer I either use it directly as a moisturizer as well or after a watery/gel consistence cream , and after around 15 min I apply make up if needed. its one of the few sun creams that do not hurt my eyes. It can be a bit shiny on your skin, but I guess that will also depend on your skin type.
reviews.zh: 我之前用緊 Comfy water 版本，效果都幾好，但總覺得佢冇真正完全吸收入皮膚。我係混合性皮膚，呢款我可以話啱我啱啱好。夏天我會直接當保濕霜用，或者喺水狀／啫喱質地嘅面霜之後用，大約十五分鐘之後，如有需要就化妝。佢係少數唔會刺痛我眼睛嘅防曬之一。可能會令皮膚有少少光澤，不過我諗呢點都要睇你嘅皮膚類型。

reviews.text: i was very sad when Purito discontinued their previous sunscreen but I’m so glad i came across this one. The texture is different compared to the other one. This one gives you more glow while the other one gave you a silky look on the skin. All in all, I love this sunscreen so much. It has no fragrance, does not break me out (i break out from a lot of products and i immediately fall in love with a product if it doesn’t break me out and this is the one!!), and it does not sting my eyes!! Another thing I noticed after a day out of having this sunscreen on, it made my skin feel so soft and hydrated. I think this is the perfect sunscreen and i love the glow it gives me too!
reviews.zh: Purito 停產咗之前嗰款防曬，我好傷心，但好開心俾我搵到呢款。質地同之前嗰款唔同。呢款令皮膚更有光澤，之前嗰款就令皮膚有絲滑感。總括嚟講，我非常鍾意呢款防曬。佢冇香料，唔會令我爆痘（我好多產品都會令我爆痘，所以只要唔會令我爆痘嘅產品，我就會即刻愛上，而呢款正正係咁！！），而且唔會刺痛我嘅眼睛！！另外，用咗一日之後，我留意到皮膚感覺好柔軟、水潤。我覺得呢款係最完美嘅防曬，我好鍾意佢帶嚟嘅光澤！

reviews.text: I love the conscientious formulations of the Purito brand. They really are a standard bearer for EWG (Environmental Working Group) guidelines. The chemical sunscreen ingredients (for UVA : Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine,Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate; for UVB :Ethylhexyl Triazone) are newer, safer for our endocrine systems and photostable for more than the standard 2 hours. Even though it has a physical sunblock as well (titanium dioxide), I still re-apply because all chemical filters still photo-degrade, and the physical barrier of Ti will wear off throughout the day the same way that make-up will. I just don't reapply this one, as it's shiny. I use an SPF BB cream instead, so that I don't have to fuss with powder. This unscented version is also a great improvement over the previous eucalyptus scent that only koalas liked.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意 Purito 嘅配方理念。佢哋真係 EWG（環境工作小組）指引嘅標杆。化學防曬成分（UVA：Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine、Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate；UVB：Ethylhexyl Triazone）係比較新、對內分泌系統比較安全，而且耐光性超過標準嘅兩小時。雖然佢都有物理防曬成分（二氧化鈦），我仍然會補擦，因為所有化學濾光劑都會受光降解，而二氧化鈦形成嘅物理屏障亦會隨日內消磨，就好似化妝咁。我唔會補擦呢款，因為佢會令皮膚反光。我改用有 SPF 嘅 BB 霜，咁就唔使再搞粉。呢款無香味版本，亦係好大改善，之前嗰款桉樹香味，只有無尾熊會鍾意。

reviews.text: When I saw that they came out with another sunscreen, I just had to have this. I’ve loved their centella green level unscented in spite of the controversy. To me it was more like a good moisturizer with some spf, so I was sad to see it was discontinued. This one is just as moisturizing and lightweight as it’s predecessor, it has no white cast, and is very spreadable. It is a bit on the shiny side, but it wasn’t too bad, you can put some setting powder on your face and the shiny goes away. I have sensitive, acne prone, oily dehydrated skin and this didn’t break me out. And it didnt pill underneath my skin tint which is always a plus. After their controversy, I had a hard time finding sunscreens I liked, I tried a bunch of other Korean and American ones, but I didn’t like any of them, so I was glad purito came out with another sunscreen. So far I really love this one and would repurchase
reviews.zh: 我一直好鍾意 Purito 嘅 centella green level unscented，儘管有爭議。我覺得佢係一款有少少防曬功能嘅好保濕霜，所以知道停產我好唔捨得。呢款都係咁保濕、咁輕盈，同前代一樣，冇白色殘留，而且好易推開。佢有啲反光，但唔算太差，你可以喺面上撲少少定妝粉，光澤就會減少。我係敏感、易長痘、油性、缺水嘅皮膚，呢款冇令我爆痘。而且喺膚色霜底下唔會搓泥，呢點一直都係好處。自從佢哋出咗爭議之後，我好難搵到自己鍾意嘅防曬，試過好多韓國同美國品牌都唔鍾意，所以好開心 Purito 再推出新防曬。目前我好鍾意呢款，會再買。

reviews.text: This has to be the most lightweight sunscreen i’ve ever tried. the SPF50 formula ticked off all the right boxes for me - lightweight? check. good consistency? it's lotion-like, so it goes on so smoothly. non-greasy? it has a velvety & weightless finish! it has both physical & chemical filters, with soothing plant extracts like centella asiatica & madecassoside, antioxidants & stearic acid to strengthen your skin barrier so it looks visibly younger & feels healthier. I think this SPF is great for DRY SKIN and people who prefer short AM routine as it can replace your moisturiser.
reviews.zh: 呢款可能係我試過最輕盈嘅防曬。SPF50 配方令我所有想要嘅條件都做到——輕盈？✔ 質地好？佢似乳液咁，所以推開好順滑。冇油膩感？佢有絲絨感同無重感嘅質地！佢有物理同化學濾光劑，仲有舒緩嘅植物提取物，例如積雪草（Centella asiatica）同 madecassoside，仲有抗氧化劑同硬脂酸，幫助加強皮膚屏障，令皮膚睇落更年輕、感覺更健康。我覺得呢款防曬好啱乾性皮膚，同埋想要簡短早上護膚程序嘅人，因為佢可以代替保濕霜。
